note: Data colours for the branding derivation (WEB-007), not UI styling. The base colours and default primary are generated from docs/brand/tokens/tokens.json into colour.tokens.generated.json (scripts/gen-branding-colours.mjs, drift test in scripts/). white, carbonDeep and carbonInk are the constants of docs/brand/tools/themelib.py (colour.test.ts checks them against the tokens). Kept in JSON so the tokens-only gate, which scans TS and CSS, sees no colour literals in code.
